name: Star Interplanetary Broad Search
description: Patched-conic interplanetary mission design by the Star broad-search algorithm (Landau, Campagnola & Pellegrini 2022): pre-generated Arora-Russell Lambert arcs across a discretized encounter grid, patched by powered flybys, with primer-vector mid-arc deep-space-maneuver placement, returning a Pareto set of trajectories. C++ port of the MIT Python reference UzTak/star-search. Threaded (isomorphic wasi-threads); planetary ephemeris is supplied as data on a typed $OEM port, never fetched.

attribution.algorithmOrigin: The Star algorithm is originally due to Damon Landau. The vendored upstream is an independent open re-implementation; this module is a C++ port of that re-implementation.
algorithmCitations: Landau, D., Campagnola, S., & Pellegrini, E. (2022). Star searches for patched-conic trajectories. The Journal of the Astronautical Sciences, 69(6), 1613-1648. https://doi.org/10.1007/s40295-022-00350-y
Landau, D. (2018). Efficient maneuver placement for automated trajectory design. Journal of Guidance, Control, and Dynamics, 41(7), 1531-1541.
Arora, N., & Russell, R. P. (2013). A fast and robust multiple revolution Lambert algorithm using a cosine transformation. AAS/AIAA Astrodynamics Specialist Conference, AAS 13-728, Hilton Head, SC.

threading.parallelism: row-range over Lambert batch solves and leg/flyby database construction
threading.determinism: Output is bit-identical at every thread count: fixed row-range partitioning, preallocated output slots (never completion-order append), fixed-index-order reductions.
threading.spawnFailurePolicy: wasi.thread-spawn may return -1 (browser lane without cross-origin isolation). The inline single-threaded fallback is mandatory and produces identical output.
threading.threadCountSource: explicit parameter / environment — never hardware-concurrency detection in guest code (no SDK discovery hook exists)

acceptedTypeSets.description: Planetary body states covering the encounter epoch grid: one EPHEMERIS_DATA_BLOCK per body, CENTER_NAME = SUN, REFERENCE_FRAME = ECLIPJ2000. Themis-ruled carrier (2026-07-29). The module never fetches ephemeris; SPICE kernels are a host/app concern.

inputPorts.description: Required planetary ephemeris table. Sampled on the encounter grid, lookups are exact and no interpolation is used.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HELD — NOT A SHIPPABLE PORT. The broad-search problem definition (body sequence constraints, epoch/TOF grid discretization, delta-V / flyby / C3 caps, optional propulsion limits) has NO existing SDS record: Themis returned LACK against pin 1.165.0 on 2026-07-29. A new standard code is required and is an OWNER-RATIFICATION stop, tracked in graph task sds-star-search-mission-design-records. This wildcard is a placeholder that the SDK compliance gate WILL reject (wildcard-port-type, pluginCompliance.js:536-544) — it is recorded rather than hidden so the intent is legible; it is replaced by the typed declaration the moment the code is ratified.

inputPorts.description: Search problem definition. PORT SURFACE HELD pending SDS ratification.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HELD — NOT A SHIPPABLE PORT. The Pareto trajectory-solution set (repeated candidate: ordered encounter list with body/epoch/v-infinity in-out/turn angle/powered-flyby delta-V/periapsis radius; repeated DSM list; per-candidate totals) has NO existing SDS record: Themis returned LACK against pin 1.165.0 on 2026-07-29 (OCM.Maneuver is the closest legal carrier for a SINGLE planned burn but its payload is untyped DATA:[string] and there is no multi-solution container anywhere in SDS). New standard code required — OWNER-RATIFICATION stop, tracked in sds-star-search-mission-design-records.

outputPorts.description: Pareto-optimal trajectory set. PORT SURFACE HELD pending SDS ratification.

methods.description: Runs the full EncounterDB -> LegDatabase -> FlybyDB -> streaming combo fold -> tfilter pipeline and returns the Pareto-filtered trajectory set.
